text: Hi Ònia - if your partner an Israeli citizen (their religion/nationality doesn't matter) then you can do the partnership visa, but you will have to be living together as a couple (it's not a boyfriend/girlfriend visa, but a visa for serious couples wanting to build a shared life together). Also in any case, it is very unlikely you will be able to apply before your visa expires, as it usually takes a lot time to get the documents for the application ready. You can read more about the process on our website here https://aic.org.il/the-gradual-process-birds-eye-view/
